svg.aria-label: Terminal-style profile card for Michael Bordelon (cantyoudobetter). Role: CTO @ Ways2Well + ReviveRX. Home Base: Texas / wherever the airplane lands. Education: Texas A&M - Mechanical Engineering. Platform.Shifts: 8-bit to PC to mainframe to web to mobile to AI. Shipped.To: 500K+ practitioners & patients; 100K+ construction pros. Patents: 4 granted - glucose, trucking, dispensing. Exits: 5 - founded, built, grown. Languages.Code: Python, C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript; SQL, Ruby, Lua + whatever the job needs. Languages.Human: English, Engineer, Chilton; Hex, NOTAM, METAR. Currently: AI-native healthcare platform; Clinical intimacy at scale; Human optimization + longevity; Agentic systems that cut friction; Developer experience that doesn't suck; Still writing actual code. Previously: Healthcare systems; Pharmacy robotics + remote dispensing; EHRs before SaaS was cool; Enterprise architecture; Non-invasive blood glucose monitor; Construction tech. Side.Quests: Airplanes, Handbuilt Race Cars; Sailing, Camping, Snowboarding; Running, Cooking, Writing. Books: The Black Swan, Garden of Lies. Long.Game: Live long enough to die on Mars. Status: Still curious. Still sharpening the stone. Current.Hypothesis: Technology's highest purpose may be to create the conditions in which humans can afford to be more human. family.tree: Sheri Events By Sheri, LLC; Blake AI PhD, Researcher at SpaceXAI; Camilla Polymath Economist; Grant Tech and Ops at SF 49ers; Jayce Tech Lead @ TasteLabs; Zoe Canine Extraordinaire. contact.ping: michael.d.bordelon@gmail.com; x.com/cantyoudobester; linkedin.com/in/mikebordelon.
